# corpus: a kind: Secret with a literal value among the placeholders, which must STILL refuse
# expect: refused
# refs:   the paired positive that bounds the k8s-template rule
# shape:  a kind: Secret manifest whose values are placeholders EXCEPT one literal (a short synthetic base64 password, a dozen chars — deliberately below the high-entropy threshold, so the k8s-template rule and NOT entropy is what refuses it)
# why:    the template exemption is per-value; one literal value among placeholders is a decrypted Secret and keeps the refusal
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-credentials
type: Opaque
stringData:
  username: <REDACTED>
  password: c3VwZXItcHc=
  api-token: {{ vault.token }}
```
